stances_toward.note: For a decade Ankara treated the YPG-led SDF as the PKK's Syrian arm and the defence minister said in 2026 that the pressure would continue 'until security objectives are met'. After the 10 Mar 2025 Abdi-al-Sharaa agreement, the 30 Jan 2026 integration deal (Ankara: 'one state, one army', transparent implementation) and the SDF's own announcement on 25 Aug 2026 that it dissolved as an independent force, the target is gone, so the grade is rival (warming) and not the adversary of earlier years; Erdogan and the AKP presented it as success. Grade C: it is our reading of the structure; the integration is self-reported and its depth untested. Bond - grievance: the PKK war.

relations_to.summary: Turkey's aim is the end of the SDF as an autonomous armed force; Ankara welcomed the Damascus-SDF integration deal of 30 Jan 2026 and Mazloum Abdi announced on 25 Aug 2026 that the SDF had dissolved as an independent force and completed integration into the Syrian army; Erdogan called it a step to a 'Terror-Free Region'. Integration is self-reported.
